summary: Fairly flat kerb on a quiet street, homes 15-20 m both sides.

best_section.where: Carrington Road east kerb, 25-40 m north of the first house on the east side

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 20-21 m away on the east side and 15 m or more across the road; no bush backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on the west side; kerb has room for a van.
drivers.convention: Residential parking is normal here but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Dwellings 15-21 m away on both sides
Steeper (about 5% mean) elsewhere on the stretch
Mapped gate 166 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover on the east verge shades the kerb in the afternoon; open to the morning sun on the west side.
